title: Understanding K-means Clustering
text: K-means clustering is an iterative algorithm that aims to partition a dataset into K distinct, non-overlapping subsets (clusters).

title: Initial Placement of Centroids
text: The initial placement of centroids can significantly affect the final cluster assignments in K-means clustering.

title: Convergence in K-means
text: K-means clustering converges to a local minimum, which may not be the global minimum, depending on the initial placement of centroids.

title: Effect of Initial Centroids
text: Consider how different initial placements of centroids might lead to different clustering results.
